sections.title: NVDA
sections.lede: Nvidia beats Q3 expectations as AI infrastructure spending accelerates

stories.headline: NVDA Surges 6% on Strong Data Center Demand
stories.dek: Nvidia beats Q3 expectations as AI infrastructure spending accelerates
stories.body_md:
**Nvidia Corporation** reported quarterly earnings that exceeded Wall Street expectations, driven by continued strong demand for its data center GPUs.

Revenue reached $18.1 billion, up 34% year-over-year, with data center segment growing 41%. CEO Jensen Huang highlighted enterprise AI adoption as a key growth driver.

stories.headline: Nvidia lifts data-center outlook on sustained accelerator demand
stories.dek: The company guided above consensus and said supply remains the binding constraint through the first half.
stories.body_md:
Nvidia raised its data-center revenue outlook, pointing to order books that extend well beyond current capacity. Management described supply, not demand, as the limiting factor.

The guidance implies **sequential growth** through the first half, with the company noting that advanced packaging capacity is being added faster than previously planned.

Analysts had expected a more cautious tone given the pace of prior increases.

stories.headline: Nvidia expands packaging partnership to add capacity in 2027
stories.dek: A multi-year agreement adds advanced packaging lines dedicated to accelerator production.
stories.body_md:
The agreement reserves dedicated advanced-packaging capacity beginning in 2027, addressing the bottleneck management has repeatedly flagged.

Terms were not disclosed.

stories.headline: Nvidia files updated export compliance disclosure

sections.title: Energy
sections.lede: Crude drifts lower on inventory builds while refiners hold margin discipline.

stories.headline: Crude slides as commercial inventories build for a third week
stories.dek: Builds came in well above the consensus estimate, pressuring front-month contracts.
stories.body_md:
Commercial crude inventories rose for a third consecutive week, exceeding expectations and sending front-month contracts lower.

Product stocks were broadly flat.

stories.headline: Oil Prices Drop 3% on OPEC+ Production Hike Signals
stories.dek: Brent crude falls to $82 as Saudi Arabia hints at output increase
stories.body_md:
Energy markets sold off after Saudi Arabia's energy minister suggested OPEC+ may increase production quotas in December.

**Brent crude** fell to $82.15/barrel while WTI dropped to $78.50. Analysts expect volatility ahead of next month's meeting.

stories.headline: Refiner signals extended maintenance at Gulf Coast complex
stories.dek: Turnaround work pushes into the next quarter, trimming throughput guidance.
stories.body_md:
Maintenance at the complex will extend into the next quarter, with throughput guidance trimmed accordingly.

The company left its capital budget unchanged.

stories.headline: Crude Oil Inventories Rise 2.4M Barrels
stories.dek: EIA data shows build as refiners slow runs ahead of maintenance
stories.body_md: Weekly crude stockpiles increased more than expected, with refinery utilization dropping to 88.2%.

stories.headline: Natural Gas Futures Jump 5% on Cold Snap Forecast
stories.dek: Early winter weather pattern boosts heating demand outlook
stories.body_md: Natural gas prices rallied as forecasters predict colder-than-normal temperatures across the Midwest and Northeast in November.

stories.headline: Natural gas storage report lands in line with forecasts

sections.title: Macro
sections.lede: Rate-cut odds firm up after a softer read on services inflation.

stories.headline: Fed Minutes Show Split on Rate Path
stories.dek: Several officials favored pause, citing inflation progress
stories.body_md:
Minutes from the September FOMC meeting revealed divisions among officials about the pace of future rate hikes.

While the committee raised rates 25bp to 3.75%, several members argued for a pause to assess economic impact. Core PCE inflation has fallen to 2.7%.

stories.headline: US Dollar Index Falls to 6-Month Low
stories.dek: Fed dovish pivot weighs on greenback
stories.body_md: The US Dollar Index (DXY) dropped to 102.5, its lowest level since April, as traders price in a slower pace of Fed rate hikes.

sources.title: Dollar Index Falls on Fed Pivot

sections.title: Macro
sections.lede: Rate-cut odds firm up after a softer read on services inflation.

stories.headline: Services inflation cools more than expected in latest print
stories.dek: The deceleration strengthens the case for an earlier move, though officials remain split.
stories.body_md:
Services prices decelerated more than forecast, the softest reading in several months.

Policymakers remain divided on timing, with several preferring to see a second confirming print before shifting their stance.

sections.title: Semiconductors
sections.lede: Memory pricing dominates the tape as foundry capacity stays tight into the new year.

stories.headline: AMD Announces MI350 AI Accelerator Launch
stories.dek: New GPU targets Nvidia's H100 with competitive pricing
stories.body_md:
AMD unveiled its MI350 AI accelerator, positioning it as a cost-effective alternative to Nvidia's H100.

The chip offers 80% of H100 performance at 60% of the price, according to early benchmarks.

stories.headline: AMD sets launch window for next-generation server parts
stories.dek: The refresh targets a first-quarter availability date, narrowing the gap with competing roadmaps.
stories.body_md:
AMD confirmed a first-quarter launch window, with volume availability guided to follow a quarter later.

The company reiterated its full-year capital plans.

stories.headline: Broadcom Wins Hyperscaler Design Win for AI Networking
stories.dek: Custom ASIC for data center interconnect boosts revenue outlook
stories.body_md: Broadcom announced a major design win with an unnamed hyperscaler for AI networking ASICs, expected to contribute $2B annually starting 2027.

stories.headline: Foundry utilization holds near capacity on advanced nodes
stories.dek: Leading-edge lines remain effectively sold out, with pricing discipline intact.
stories.body_md:
Utilization on leading-edge nodes stayed near practical capacity, and management signalled no intention to discount.

Mature nodes continue to run *materially* softer.

stories.headline: TSM Raises Capex Guidance to $45B for 2027
stories.dek: TSMC accelerates 2nm production amid rising AI chip demand
stories.body_md:
**Taiwan Semiconductor** announced it will increase 2027 capital expenditure to $45 billion, up from previous $40B guidance, to accelerate 2-nanometer production capacity.

The move comes as hyperscalers compete for cutting-edge chips for AI workloads.

stories.headline: Lithography orders slip on timing, backlog unchanged
Micron Guides Q1 Revenue Above Consensus
stories.dek: Memory chip demand rebounds in data center, automotive
stories.body_md: Micron Technology projected Q1 revenue of $7.8-8.2B, above analyst estimates of $7.5B, driven by memory chip recovery.

sections.title: Financials
sections.lede: Pipeline commentary points to deferred borrowing rather than deteriorating credit.

stories.headline: Large banks flag softer loan demand in commercial segments
stories.dek: Pipeline commentary points to deferred borrowing rather than deteriorating credit.
stories.body_md:
Executives described commercial loan pipelines as slower, attributing the shift to deferred capital spending rather than credit stress.

Charge-off guidance was unchanged.

stories.headline: Trading desks post firmer quarter on rates volatility
stories.dek: Fixed-income revenue outpaced equities as rate expectations repriced.
stories.body_md:
Fixed-income trading revenue came in ahead of expectations, helped by a repricing of rate expectations through the quarter.

Equities desks were roughly flat.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs Upgrades Regional Banks to Overweight
stories.dek: Analysts see stabilization in deposit costs, credit quality
stories.body_md: Goldman Sachs upgraded the regional banking sector, noting that deposit betas have peaked and credit metrics remain healthy.

stories.headline: JPM Raises S&P 500 Target to 7,200 for Year-End
stories.dek: Bank cites resilient earnings, falling inflation risks
stories.body_md: JPMorgan strategists raised their 2026 year-end S&P 500 target from 6,800 to 7,200, citing better-than-expected earnings growth.
